nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: High-level architectural overview of the SceneSmith/ReefSmith system. It describes the agentic pipeline stages (Floor Plan, Furniture, Wall/Ceiling Accents, Manipulands) and identifies the 10 core architectural layers of the codebase.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE_UNDERWATER.md
nodes.summary: Specific architectural adaptation for underwater environments. It maps the indoor generation stages to marine ecological concepts: Seabed Topography, Structural Reef Placement, Coral/Sponge Accents, and Micro-Habitat Arrangement.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project entry point containing a comprehensive overview of ReefSmith. It includes detailed installation guides (local and Docker), asset generation backend setup (SAM3D, Hunyuan3D), data preparation instructions for various datasets, and usage examples for scene generation and robot evaluation.

nodes.name: REEFSMITH_REFACTOR_PROMPT.md
nodes.summary: A detailed system transformation prompt used to guide the refactoring of SceneSmith (indoor) into ReefSmith (underwater). It outlines the core domain translations, prompt engineering requirements for marine assets, and pipeline orchestration changes.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: The main Python project configuration file. It defines project metadata, specifies Python 3.11 requirement, and lists extensive dependencies including Drake for physics, Blender for rendering, and OpenAI/Gemini for LLM agents.

nodes.name: text_to_3d_pipeline.md
nodes.summary: Technical deep-dive into the 7-stage pipeline that converts text descriptions into simulation-ready 3D models. It covers image generation, geometry creation using SAM3D/Hunyuan3D, VLM-based physics analysis, canonicalization, and Drake SDF generation.

tour.title: The Vision: Automated Text-to-Reef
tour.description: ReefSmith is designed to generate complex underwater environments without human intervention. It ensures that assets are ecologically grounded and simulation-ready, including physical properties like drag and buoyancy.

tour.title: The Orchestrator: Pipeline Entry Point
tour.description: The 'main.py' script is the heart of the system. Using Hydra for configuration management, it builds and executes experiments, coordinating multiple specialized agents through the generation lifecycle.

tour.title: Domain Translation: From Indoor to Underwater
tour.description: ReefSmith adapts indoor scene generation logic to the marine domain. This configuration file maps architectural roles like 'Floor Plan' and 'Furniture' to 'Seabed' and 'Reef' agents.

tour.title: Stage 1: Seabed Topography
tour.description: The Seabed Agent initiates the process by designing the underwater floor. It determines the topography, material composition (e.g., sand vs. rock), and the overall layout of the marine environment.

tour.title: Stage 2: Structural Reef Placement
tour.description: The Reef Agent populates the seabed with major structural elements. It strategically places large coral colonies and rock formations to create the foundation of the reef ecosystem.

tour.title: Stage 3: Ecological Accents
tour.description: The Accent Agent adds complexity to the reef by placing smaller corals, sponges, and seafan accents, ensuring a visually rich and biologically diverse environment.

tour.title: Stage 4: Micro-Habitat Population
tour.description: In the final generation stage, the Micro-Habitat Agent nestles small life forms like anemones and sea urchins into realistic crevices and surfaces, completing the ecological narrative.

tour.title: Intelligent Asset Routing
tour.description: The Asset Router decides how to fulfill an agent's request. It can retrieve existing high-quality assets from datasets like HSSD or Objaverse, or generate new 3D geometry on-the-fly using SAM3D or Hunyuan3D.

tour.title: Simulation-Ready Export
tour.description: ReefSmith goes beyond visuals by generating SDFormat (SDF) files. This utility calculates physical properties for every object, enabling the scene to be immediately used in physics simulators like Drake.

tour.title: Autonomous Robot Evaluation
tour.description: The system includes a framework for evaluating robot policies within the generated reefs. It resolves natural language tasks into geometric predicates and validates success using Vision-Language Models.
